  * Cut short-acting insulin if you are planning for higher intensity workouts. Your exact dosing depends on factors like your basal rate and how often you work out and whether you're going to continue being active.

- **Check blood sugars after exercise**: Blood sugar can be low right after exercise but start spiking a few hours later. Keep this in mind when you make post-exercise meals and plan to monitor your glucose levels closely in case you need to adjust your medications.

Talk to an endocrinologist to get a more personalized recommendation.
